## Switched from GetCourse mainly because…
Switched from GetCourse mainly because I wanted to stop waiting on a technical specialist every time the funnel needed changing. In AXL I rebuild it myself — new setup live in an evening, run it two weeks, keep it or roll it back. The MCP integration means the AI works with our actual data rather than whatever I paste into a prompt, so segmentation and reporting are just requests now. Email deliverability is the weak spot: sending domains drop out and you don't get warned, so I check it manually. Otherwise it replaced three tools for us and I'd pick it again.

Guns N’ Roses fans were stunned after Axl Rose completely lost it on stage in Buenos Aires, Argentina. During the very first song of the night, Axl could be seen visibly angry — before throwing his mic straight at the drum kit, kicking the bass drum, and storming off stage in front of a massive crowd.

This wild moment has fans asking one big question: what set him off? Was it bad sound? Frustration with the new drummer Isaac Carpenter? Or something deeper happening inside the Guns N’ Roses camp?
